 News › News News › CAT 2026: IIM Indore releases admit card released, check details here CAT 2026: IIM Indore releases admit card released, check details here
 TNN Updated: Nov 7, 2026, 11:34 IST The Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Indore has released the admit card for the Common Admission Test (CAT) 2026. Registered candidates can download their hall tickets from the official website, using their CAT application login ID and password.
 CAT is a national-level management entrance examination conducted for admission to postgraduate management programmes offered by the IIMs and other participating business schools.
 The admit card download window will remain open from November 6 to November 29, 2026. Candidates are advised to download their hall tickets well in advance and check the details mentioned on them carefully. A printed copy of the admit card and a valid photo identity proof must be carried to the examination centre. 
 Candidates will not be allowed to enter the examination hall without these documents.
 Steps to download 
 Candidates can follow these steps to access their admit cards:
 Visit the official website at iimcat.ac.in .
 Click on the CAT 2026 admit card download link on the homepage.
 Enter the registered CAT user ID and password.
 Submit the login credentials.
 The admit card will appear on the screen.
 Check the details mentioned on the hall ticket.
 Download the admit card and take a printout for examination day use.
 Details to check on admit card 
 The hall ticket contains important information about the candidate and the examination. Candidates should verify the following details after downloading it:
 Candidate's name and registration number
 Photograph and signature
 Examination date and slot
 Reporting time
 Examination centre name and address
 Examination-related instructions
 In case of any discrepancy, candidates should contact the CAT authorities through the official website for clarification.
 Exam Date and Slot Timings 
 IIM Indore will conduct CAT 2026 on November 29, 2026, in three sessions. The examination will be held for 120 minutes, with each candidate's allotted slot and reporting time mentioned on the admit card.
 The examination schedule is as follows:
 Slot Reporting time Examination time 
 Slot 1 (Morning) 7:00 am–7:30 am 8:30 am–10:30 am 
 Slot 2 (Afternoon) 11:00 am–11:30 am 12:30 pm–2:30 pm 
 Slot 3 (Evening) 3:00 pm–3:30 pm 4:30 pm–6:30 pm 
 Candidates must report to their allotted examination centres according to the schedule mentioned on their admit cards. They should also read the examination-day instructions carefully and keep the required documents ready before leaving for the centre.
 Candidates' CAT scores will be considered along with the respective institutes' admission criteria for shortlisting applicants for subsequent selection rounds. These may include written assessments, group discussions, and personal interviews, depending on the institute.
